patterns: Overwhelmingly direct single-fact Guru items: founder of Khalsa (Gobind Singh), compiler of Adi Granth (Arjan), Amritsar founded/land from Akbar (Ram Das), executed by Aurangzeb (Tegh Bahadur), Nanak's successor (Angad).
Places: Nanakana birthplace, Patna (Gobind Singh's birth), Nanded (Gobind Singh's resting place).
Ranjit Singh: capital Lahore, Sukerchakia misl, Treaty of Amritsar 1809, successor Kharak Singh, last ruler Duleep Singh; Banda's original name Lachhman Dev.
APPSC itself asks only the simplest version (tenth Guru, scripture = Adi Granth, capital Lahore); app's multi-statement and chronology items are deeper than PYQs.
